scientific_integrity: The exact infinite-parameter proof is analytic. Exact rational finite checks are supplementary. The reported novelty is the sharp universal diagonal extremum, rigid equality case, dimension barrier and bounded failure interval, not the known scalar extrapolation sign loss.
scientific_limitations: Classification concerns the diagonal entries of a single passive or active one-step Richardson extrapolation applied to a symmetric, connected, weighted graph Laplacian; it does not guarantee all off-diagonal entries or repeated active-step positivity. Closely relevant 2010 stability papers were available mainly as abstracts; unindexed priority risk remains.
title: The sharp 28–29 self-transition barrier for Richardson-accelerated graph diffusion
